## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 34. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke starts by qualifying the label: 'new' head coach is a loose term here, as Hauser was the assistant head coach and DC for the Bobcats before HC Brian Smith was placed on leave at the end of the regular season. He then makes the broader point — there's something to be said about continuity in college football in 2026, and Hauser follows Smith and Tim Albin, who were both on the staffs of their predecessors. He grounds the hire regionally: Hauser has spent his entire FBS career in the MAC and is plenty familiar with the Buckeye State as a Columbus native and Wittenberg University grad, so he should be able to keep getting good in-house talent from a top-10, borderline top-five, state for high school football.
